summary: Created appworker on node1 and persistently configured login sessions for 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Both soft and hard limits were verified before and after reboot.
actions_performed: Created appworker with home directory and /bin/bash.
Added /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft and hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256.
Verified the effective limits in a fresh PAM-backed appworker login session.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed the boot identity changed and configuration persisted.

evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure persistent resource limits
evidence.summary: Shows the account, root-owned limits configuration, and effective soft/hard limits of nofile=8192 and nproc=256 in an appworker login session.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a8d103a5-6bbc-4adc-a4b1-7b779fe8fdc3, running system state, persistent account/configuration, and recovered effective limits.
